opacity.$description: Alpha steps for STATE expression. Role keys, not a percent ladder: the only real signal in the codebase was that 0.5 consistently means "disabled" — a numeric ramp would invent precision we don't use. Deliberately NOT nested under color as canonical GTC does (global.color.opacity.N): that would emit --color-opacity-*, and --color-* is a Tailwind namespace, so every step would masquerade as a colour and generate bg-/text-/border- utilities. Tailwind has no --opacity-* namespace, so these generate no utilities — consume them as opacity-(--opacity-disabled) or in plain CSS.

disabled.$description: The 19 `disabled:opacity-50` sites. WCAG imposes no contrast minimum on disabled controls, but 0.5 keeps them readable enough to identify.

loading.$description: In-flight controls that stay legible while non-interactive (button/guarded-action loading).
